appearance.styleDesc: Glass shows translucent panels and cards over a soft colour gradient. Standard is the solid look.
appearance.reduceTransparencyDesc: Solid panels without blur or gradient, for sharper contrast. The system's Reduce transparency (macOS, read at launch), Increase contrast and forced colours (Windows) turn it on by themselves.
appearance.systemReducedTransparency: Your system asks for less transparency or more contrast, so panels stay solid anyway.
